critical_code_review_comments: design_director.score_product writes design_scorecard on GET /score/{pid} — read-side mutation is intentional ('always freshest' UX) but worth documenting; also fine because auto-gate uses the same computed value.

auto_gate: when auto_improve is False OR product already passing, it writes design_scorecard but skips the design_gate write later — actually re-check: auto_gate always writes design_gate at line 325 with $set unconditional, so this is fine.
issue_tags mapping uses category name string matching against _ISSUE_TAGS dict; since category names include ™ chars, keep tests in sync if categories are ever renamed. Present code is correct.
product_recipes.get_recipe falls back to a default 'QRU Document Recipe™' which will fail the recipe-label test only for unknown types. Current corpus is all known types — safe.

manufacturing2._certify swallows auto-gate exceptions (non-blocking) — correct behavior since Founder review still runs; consider surfacing gate failures in notifications so silent failures are observable.
design_director.telemetry / references correctly strip mongo _id before returning. Good.
